column1: # what: What it costs to own and run the machine yourself, not a rate anyone charged
# publisher: University of Illinois, Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics (Dale Lattz and Gary Schnitkey)

# basis: New machinery held 10 years (combine 7), diesel at $3.00 a gallon, labor at $22.00 an hour, overhead (depreciation, interest, insurance, housing, repairs); no profit. Field operations are sized for a 1,400 acre grain farm; the combine is 470 hp on 2,500 acres; bales assume 1.3 tons an acre.
